limitations: No qualifying grid configuration is not a proof about all possible classifiers or thresholds.
Primary public retention is 67 cases per split, not guaranteed independent people; render conditions are correlated within identities.
Scene labels were manually reviewed by the same builder; seven ambiguous sources remain unknown.
Constructed screens/prints are 2D proxies and busts are low-poly; no measured lamp optics, camera JPEG quality or lux.
COCO val2017 is a published MoveNet evaluation dataset; publisher training included COCO train2017. Identity/pretraining leakage was not audited.
Presence is evaluated per image, not per sitting/event. Static confidence and the mean of 17 keypoint scores are not liveness evidence.
No temporal movement, moving screens, camera ego-motion, empty-room day/night run, or private lamp/customer data.
Public float16 CPU model; no accuracy parity to the shipped int16 NPU model and no ARM64/end-to-end/voice-load measurement.
No calibrated yaw/blur operating limits follow from this study; these need separate recognition and temporal evidence.
No training, deployment, merge, or change to product defaults.

runtime.LiteRT_delegate: XNNPACK CPU, default delegate reported by generated controls

timing.boundary: Decoded RGB through output features, includes fixed 192x192 CPU crop and image-only measurement. File/decode/model-load excluded; first model call cold, no study warmup. Same shared Mac, not voice-path or board latency.
